data.name: 价值投资者：50年生涯
data.detailed_description:
In this game, you will step into the shoes of an independent investor. Whether you are a seasoned veteran or just starting out, enjoy the journey ahead. This game features no specific challenges; you are free to pursue higher final returns.

The core mechanic is the "Wait"​ button. After conducting your research and making purchase decisions, you can advance to the next year with a single click. In value investing, research, buy, wait, and hold for the long term—these are the greatest virtues.

Each session features 30 randomly generated Chinese listed companies to choose from. However, as the developer, I suggest limiting your selection to 10. In value investing, an overly large portfolio dilutes your focus and hinders the power of compounding.

You may choose between "Half Position" and "Full Position" options based on your strategy. Dive into the company details screen, which is divided into four key sections: Financials, Fundamentals, Valuation, and Industry Comparison. Master these core elements of value investing.

As a simulation game centered on value investing, it serves as both a training ground and a testing lab. Learn theories in the real world and apply them here, or gain experience in-game before taking on the real stock market.

Have fun, and may you practice value investing for life—both in this game and in the real world.

Note: This game is developed and maintained by a single person, so my capabilities are limited. Meanwhile, the world of value investing is extremely profound and complex, so there may inevitably be some omissions and shortcomings. I hope every player can offer their valuable feedback to help the developer improve it further. Thank you.
